summary.name: choosintexas
summary.one_liner: choosintexas (Choosin Texas AI) is a paid, independent fan tool that turns one adult photo into a ~15-second 9:16 vertical "emo rooftop" cover video.
use_cases: Making a TikTok, Reels or Shorts trend post from one photo
Creating a friend challenge or birthday roast clip
Producing a late-night meme edit in the emo rooftop style
Generating a vertical AI clip without writing a prompt
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes one adult photo uploaded without a text prompt and generates a roughly 15-second 9:16 vertical video in a fixed "Choosin' Texas Emo" look (night parking garage, cream wall, city lights). Output is a 720p or 480p MP4 that the user downloads. Pricing is pay-per-render via credit packs with Stripe checkout, and failed renders restore credits. The page says photos stay local for preview and renders use a short-lived private link. It advises labeling posts as AI-generated and gives photo tips such as full-body shots and even lighting.
notable: One photo, no prompt: fixed locked emo rooftop template
Pay-once credit packs with no subscription; failed renders refund credits
Output sized 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Explicitly an independent fan tool, not affiliated with any label or original performer
caveats: Adults only, and only photos of yourself or people who agreed; no children, celebrities or strangers
Paid per render: from $6.90 for one 480p (50 credits) or $9.90 for one 720p HD (100 credits); the page's headline 'From $6.90' conflicts with the $9.90 720p price
Render links expire, so MP4s must be saved promptly; the page does not keep a permanent gallery
